title: Nvidia buys Mellanox for $6.9B

sources.quote: Pursuant to the agreement, NVIDIA will acquire all of the issued and outstanding common shares of Mellanox for $125 per share in cash, representing a total enterprise value of approximately $6.9 billion.

explain: Nvidia bought Israeli networking-chip maker Mellanox for about $6.9B in cash, closing in April 2020. Mellanox's high-speed links became the networking backbone of Nvidia's AI data-center systems.
